description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Current status of Payment Voucher. Possible values are : active, consumed, expired, failure.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in, in, not_in

Example → status[is_not] = "active, consumed, expired"

is.description: \* \`active\` - Active and ready to be consumed \* \`consumed\` - Consumed for a transaction and cannot be used again \* \`expired\` - Expired before consumed and cannot be used again \* \`failure\` - Failed to create the voucher due to gateway rejection

is_not.description: \* \`active\` - Active and ready to be consumed \* \`consumed\` - Consumed for a transaction and cannot be used again \* \`expired\` - Expired before consumed and cannot be used again \* \`failure\` - Failed to create the voucher due to gateway rejection
